title: Dolphin with sparkly eyes
svg:

    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8fd8ff'/>

  <!-- water spout sparkles -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='18' r='2.5' fill='#bff0ff'/>

  <path d='M46 44 Q50 26 62 30 Q56 36 54 48 Z' fill='#2f88bd'/>
  <!-- tail fluke -->
  <path d='M18 70 Q8 58 14 50 Q22 56 26 62 Q22 68 18 70 Z' fill='#3a9fd6'/>
  <path d='M18 70 Q10 82 16 90 Q24 82 26 74 Q22 72 18 70 Z' fill='#3a9fd6'/>

  <circle cx='68' cy='56' r='5' fill='#1a4a66'/>
  <circle cx='69.5' cy='54.5' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='66.5' cy='58' r='1' fill='#9fe6ff'/>
  <!-- tiny star sparkle near eye -->
  <path d='M78 48 l1.2 2.6 l2.8 0.4 l-2 2 l0.5 2.8 l-2.5 -1.3 l-2.5 1.3 l0.5 -2.8 l-2 -2 l2.8 -0.4 Z' fill='#fff8b0'/>
  <!-- pectoral fin -->
  <path d='M58 72 Q54 84 60 88 Q66 84 64 74 Z' fill='#2f88bd'/>
